title: Pause & Restore
subtitle: Before December asks more of you, take a morning for yourself.
shortDescription:
As the year draws to a close, it can be easy to spend our energy caring for everyone and everything else.

This is a space to slow down, reconnect with your body and explore what support looks like for you during a season that asks a lot from us.

A blend of movement, reflection and mindfulness.
fullDescription:
You don't have to wait until January to prioritise yourself.

The end of the year can bring a lot of expectations.

More plans.
More commitments.
More people needing your time and energy.

It can be tempting to push through December and promise yourself you’ll slow down later.

Pause & Restore is an opportunity to create that space now.

A morning to move, reflect and reconnect with yourself — without pressure to achieve, fix or become a different version of you.

Why I created Pause & Restore
My work brings together rehabilitation, strength training and yoga, but the common thread is helping people work with changing bodies, energy and circumstances.
Pause & Restore brings those perspectives together in a morning designed to help you understand what your body needs, explore mindful movement and create some space before the year ends.
audienceDescription: For anyone whose calendar is filling up faster than their energy, and who wants a little space to move, slow down and work out what they need before the year ends.
suitableFor: You spend a lot of your time supporting other people and rarely create space for yourself.
Your energy, priorities or circumstances have changed and you’re figuring out what you need now.
You want to reconnect with movement without needing to achieve, improve or "start again".
You’re craving a quieter moment before the busyness of the festive season.
You want to reflect on the year and consider how you want to support yourself moving forward.
included: Time and space that is actually yours during a busy season.
Gentle, adaptable movement to reconnect with your body.
Guided reflection on what you need more, and less, of.
Practical ideas for supporting your movement and wellbeing through December.
Mindfulness and rest without pressure to achieve anything.

scheduleMarkdown:
## Sunday — Pause & Restore

- Arrive: Settle in and create some space away from the usual noise. Create space away from the busyness of the season.
- Move: Mindful, adaptable movement with options for your body and energy. Reconnect with your body through mindful movement.
- Reflect: Guided prompts to explore what is supporting you, and what you might need to let go of. Consider what you need more (and less) of as the year comes to a close.
- Restore: Slow things down with mindfulness and rest before returning to your day. Leave feeling calmer, more connected and supported.
